backtranslate_samples: create a function that backtranslates a list of samples using a collate function and generation function to produce source-target pairs
create_BacktranslationDataset: build a BacktranslationDataset that wraps a target dataset and generates backtranslated source sentences using a provided generation function
set_backtranslation_fn: set the backtranslation function on an existing BacktranslationDataset instance to enable generation at runtime
collater_backtranslation: merge and backtranslate a batch of samples into a mini-batch with generated source and original target pairs
review_BacktranslationDataset_size: review the BacktranslationDataset size method to understand how it approximates source sentence length using target dataset size
